messages:
Ellie Park: Heads-up  HelioCorp wants to consolidate licenses across two subaccounts and sign early. They asked to move 75 seats from 'project-alpha' into a new subaccount 'Helio-Production', switch billing to their EU entity (HelioCorp BV, NL VAT NL123456789), and asked for a 9% early-sign discount if we get signature by 2024-12-12. Also asking for a prorated credit for unused seats through 2025-06-30. Need billing/legal/onboarding.
Carlos Mendes: 9% is within range if Finance signs off. Need current seat rate, invoice ref, and confirmation whether they want credit applied as invoice adjustment or cash refund. Also want vendor code for procurement.
Ellie Park: Seat rate is $42/mo on current annual term. They plan to reference INV-9999 on the PO. Customer prefers invoice credit applied to next two billing cycles (not cash refund). Vendor code is HC-EU-01 per their procurement note.
Yvonne Lin: Legal: we'll require an amendment + updated SOW. I'll draft prorate calc clause and a settlement clause. Also flag: customer requested an audit-friendly signature page (they may insist on wet-sign for the EU entity). If they insist, expect ~7 business days for signature return.
Tom Becker: Onboarding: moving 75 seats requires SSO remapping and group reconciliation. I can run the migration but need the CSV and a 45-min maintenance window. Recommend a weekend slot to minimize disruption.
finance-bot: Conditional approval noted: 9% discount OK if 1) signed PO referencing INV-9999, 2) DocuSign completed by 2024-12-12 OR wet-sign received by 2024-12-18, and 3) EU billing details present. If any missing, discount reverts to 5%.
Ellie Park: Customer says they prefer DocuSign but can provide wet-sign if procurement requires. I'm asking them to confirm AP contact and will request PO tonight.
Yvonne Lin: Draft clause I'll include: "Prorated Credit = seat_price * (remaining_days / 365) * number_of_seats; applied as invoice adjustment referencing INV-9999 within two billing cycles. Execution of this amendment constitutes full settlement of seat allocation claims."
signing-bot: Draft addendum uploaded: https://redwood.internal/addenda/helio-early-consolidation-v1.docx — please review and redline by EOD.
Tom Becker: Onboarding checklist created: PROV-5867543210 (link: https://onboard.redwood/checklists/PROV-5867543210)  requirements: CSV, SSO group map, maintenance window.
Carlos Mendes: Finance note: if they ask to extend term to 18 months we can increase discount to 11% but must lock pricing and require Net30. Net30 is standard; customer asked Net45, we should push back.
Ellie Park: I'll try to negotiate Net30. Customer prefers Net45 because of internal AP cycles but said they can escalate to get Net30 if needed.
Yvonne Lin: Also adding a short clause: "No further price reductions or concessions shall be available after execution of this amendment." to avoid repeated asks.
Ellie Park: I'll route DocuSign to renewals@heliocorp.com and cc legal@redwood.com. Target signature by 2024-12-10 to allow billing ops to process PO. Will post PO and CSV here when received. :thumbsup:
